Later David's rivals acknowledge that kingship belongs to his line (1 Kgs 2:15, 22), and God tears it from Solomon's son (1 Kgs 11:35). Psalm 22:28 and Obadiah 21 elevate it to cosmic scale: ultimate sovereignty belongs to Yahweh. Construct phrases like 'royal city,' 'royal throne,' and 'royal seed' extend the term into related domains."
